summary: Iteration 4 (7 new e-procurement features) tested. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases PASSED (test_iteration4_features.py). After fix, /vendor/pricelists loads, sealed banner + TOR.pdf attachment link + 'Riwayat Revisi Bid (1)' mini-timeline all visible on vendor tender BE7DA detail sheet. minor.issue: Returns 400 when tender already revealed (idempotent behavior). Acceptable but 200 with no-op would be friendlier.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (FIXED by testing agent): VendorPricelists function body was inserted inside VendorProfile's JSX return, breaking the JSX with a stray '// ============' comment token. Also Trash2 was used but not imported from lucide-react. Whole app failed to compile, then /vendor/pricelists crashed with 'Trash2 is not defined' runtime error.

issues: The row containing tender-sealed-toggle checkbox has an EMPTY visible label (see screenshot i4_create.png) — only the input checkbox is rendered next to the Bonded row, missing text like 'Sealed Bid Tender'. Users won't know what the toggle does. data-testid works but label text is missing.
Radix a11y warning persists: DialogContent requires DialogTitle (same as iter-3, non-blocking).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 features all working. The critical VendorPortal.jsx merge bug was resolved by moving the VendorPricelists function block from inside VendorProfile's JSX return to after VendorProfile ends, and adding Trash2 to the lucide-react import. Main agent should confirm the file structure is correct (grep for 'export function VendorPricelists' — should be at file end, VendorProfile complete before it).
rca of the issue: Root cause: main agent's iteration-4 edit appended VendorPricelists source code inside VendorProfile's tab==='document' <table> return block. The pasted content started with a JS line comment '// ==' which JSX/babel treated as invalid text at position 935:2, breaking compilation. Additionally Trash2 was used in the pricelist row but not imported. Reproduction: yarn start / webpack compile fails with 'SyntaxError Unexpected token (935:2)'. Even after JSX repair, /vendor/pricelists throws 'ReferenceError: Trash2 is not defined'. Mitigation: (a) close VendorProfile JSX properly and place VendorPricelists as a peer top-level export after VendorProfile closes; (b) add Trash2 to lucide-react import; (c) both applied in /app/frontend/src/pages/VendorPortal.jsx by testing agent — please review.
